review_notes: Selected Table 2 Panel A columns 1 and 2 as the principal full-sample supplier-performance test: ROA and ROE are the paper’s direct accounting-rate-of-return outcomes. Columns 3–8 decompose performance drivers; Panel B is an identifiable-customer subsample with additional customer-base controls; the later DCC lead-lag and capital-market analyses are separate extensions.

The paper defines AGE only as firm age and SG only as annual percentage sales growth; it does not report the age construction or the sales-growth denominator.
